notes: Google documents Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview as the standard ER 2 endpoint for embodied reasoning and robotics.
The model accepts text, image, video, and audio input and returns text output.
Google declares a 131,072-token input limit and a 65,536-token output limit.
The current robotics guide uses the Interactions API for gemini-robotics-er-2-preview.
Thinking is supported; Google examples explicitly use thinking_level=high and recommend medium as a latency/performance balance. No undocumented thinking modes are declared here.
Code execution, computer use, file search, function calling, Google Maps grounding, search grounding, structured outputs, URL context, caching, and Batch API are supported.
Audio generation, image generation, and Live API are explicitly unsupported.
Flex inference and Priority inference are explicitly unsupported.
Parallel function calling and MCP support are not declared in the checked model documentation and remain unknown.
Google identifies gemini-robotics-er-2-preview as the replacement for gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview, which shut down on 2026-08-31.
